items.computation: The letter sets a 30-day period running 'nach Zugang dieser Abrechnung' (from the day the statement is received), not from a fixed calendar date and not from the document's own date. No document date is printed anywhere on the letter, and no information about the actual day of receipt (Zugang) is available. Because this is a letter from a private landlord/Hausverwaltung, not a German authority, the statutory deemed-delivery rules for administrative letters (§122 AO, §41 VwVfG etc.) do not apply; receipt must be established factually (typically date of postmark + a few days, or the date the tenant can show they received it). Without either the document date or the receipt date, the start of the 30-day period - and therefore its end under §§187, 188 BGB - cannot be fixed. The tenant should check the envelope postmark or their own record of when the letter arrived and count 30 days from that day (with the last day shifting to the next business day if it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday).
